slot.brief: Projectile motion: ball thrown at an angle or dropped from a moving platform; combine the two perpendicular kinematic equations to find time of flight and range (or landing position), with simple given numbers.

stem: A ball is projected from level ground with speed $25$ m s$^{-1}$ at an angle of $37^\circ$ to the horizontal. Take $g = 10$ m s$^{-2}$, $\sin 37^\circ = 0.6$ and $\cos 37^\circ = 0.8$. What is its horizontal range?
solution:
Resolve the initial velocity: $u_x=25(0.8)=20\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ and $u_y=25(0.6)=15\,\text{m s}^{-1}$. The time of flight is $t=\dfrac{2u_y}{g}=3\,\text{s}$.\\
$$R=u_x t=20(3)=60\,\text{m}$$
